# Blocksphere

> Blocksphere bridges boardroom ambition and production-grade decentralization. We combine enterprise discipline with blockchain, Web3, and AI to deliver digital sovereignty solutions that scale, secure, and last.

Blocksphere is PT Blocksphere Teknoniaga Indonesia, an enterprise blockchain consulting and development company shipping production systems since 2017.

- [Complete company text](https://blocksphere2026.github.io/company.md): The complete public company-site content in Markdown.
- [Full LLM context](https://blocksphere2026.github.io/llms-full.txt): The complete company-site content as plain text.
